ratings.comment: What more can be said about Dr. Gondree that hasn't already been said? Specifically for CS450, make sure you partner up with classmates that are similar to your work-ethic. STUDY FOR THE EXAMS! Know you're computer architecture (CS351) and go over his powerpoints regularly! Great dude though, I will miss him, his teaching style, and SSU's CS dept!
Dr. Gondree was helpful in all office and lab times. Would take him again in any role or position. He clarifies what others attempt to teach.

Prof. Gondree provided office hours and coordinating labs. But it seems there was no communication between him and other instructor, because his method of teaching C++ was wildly different than those taught in the lecture. He relies entirely on ZyBooks and does not have original assignments. Ultimately, I learned very little from him.

Dr. Gondree is a great professor and it's clear that Computer Security is his passion. He is constantly cracking jokes which makes the otherwise DENSE powerpoint lectures more fun to get through. His labs are tricky though, especially from the mid-point on. Work with your fellow classmates on the labs and final project and you'll be good!

Gondree is one of the best CS professors at Sonoma State. He is incredibly knowledgable about a number of technical topics, and he really cares about how his students are internalizing the material. Very easy going and ready to help his students get a better understanding of topics.
Good professor. If gondree is available, take him. Good luck.

CS115 was fairly easy, the exams he allows you to use front and back of a page. You can write whatever you want on these exams including examples of code. He posts past exams on canvas for you to review. The toughest part of the class is the projects. You need an average of 60% on exams and projects to pass the class, if not its an F.
Gondree is great. Take his class for sure. He is very helpful and always does what students need in order to succeed.

Professor Gondree is really good. Having a bad day or just overslept? Easy to get an extension! Sometimes ZyLabs can be complicated. He is so funny in class and cares for his students. Makes sure that we understand even though the class can be quiet. Python with him is so fun, please consider taking him!!

Very good teacher, in his lectures he really breaks down the material so it is understandable. You can also tell he really wants his students to succeed. Attendance wasn't taken/graded but I'd say you'd be confused if you don't show up to class. The workload was not super intense and he was very clear about what was going to be on the tests.

Had him for a computer security class and also as my department advisor. Only had him during the online pandemic class but was great. He always took questions, listened to feedback and was willing to meet our needs. Some of the material was tough but he was willing to explain and work with you in office hours until you got it. Taking him again.

Gondree is a fantastic teacher. He is a caring and kind man who definitely knows his stuff. As a teacher, Gondree prefers to have the student make their own connections, and support them in their efforts to do so. If you are ever stuck in his classes, his office hours will guide you to the promised land.

He is perhaps the most caring professor I've had so far. He is very compassionate with his students. He is so helpful in office hours. He provides extra learning materials and is really clear in the way he speaks. Sometimes the topics were difficult for me but there are a lot fo opportunities to get points. I was happy with my B- and with him.

This class was super cool, it's a shame it isn't taught every semester. We don't deserve Gondree. This is his wheelhouse. You can tell how much he loves the material and he makes it very easy to understand. The labs were both fun and fascinating. He's so helpful and easy to talk to. No other prof offers as many office hours as he does. Use them!

Took him for Operating Systems during an online semester and I was really impressed with how he handled teaching online. He had a ton of zoom office hours and was incredibly willing to meet up to help on projects. Very clear and also has a sense of humor which makes the class more engaging. Super excited to have him for cs340 next semester!

Doctor Gondree is a fantastic teacher and person. He focused heavily on group activities and getting the class involved in the beginning. In the end, he focused more on having us read, then finding where students were confused by giving us no point quizzes on poll ev and lecturing on those topics. He's also a GDB wizard if you need help debugging.

Easily the best professor I've had at Sonoma State. His lectures are easy to follow and he is very accessible when you have questions. If you go into this class with any knowledge of Python, it will be a breeze.

3 projects, all group based. Canvas quizzes and Zybooks readings for credit. 2 exams. The hardest CS class I've ever taken. I think I put over 40 hours into 2 of the projects alone. That said, absolutely incredible professor as far as help outside of class. He sat on zoom for hours helping my group multiple times. I learned so much from him. A+
Very pleasant, knowledgeable, accessible, and helpful. Nothing negative to say about this guy.
Gondree is great. He truly wants every student to succeed and he works hard to make the material easy to understand. He often uses funny and helpful analogies.

Made me want to continue in the computer science major. Made complex ideas easy to understand and gave good feedback if you missed something. He wants his students to do well so he offers a lot of outside help. Amazing teacher and amazing experience.
Difficult subject with a friendly bearded teacher. Cool, collected, knowledgeable, and fair.

Not too difficult except for some of the later labs.  You have a week to complete labs, which is very generous.  Isn't the best at getting them graded/returned to you however.  Very few lectures - if you're new to unix, you'll appreciate them, if not, you may be bored.  Overall good, fun class.  You'll learn a lot but need to practice too.

He's new to SSU.  He knows the material, but isn't the best communicator of it. Discrete Math is a difficult topic to understand, so I don't fault him. Very responsive to feedback re: HW, test/quiz difficulty, etc, so DO talk to him - he may offer extra credit, allow corrections for extra points, extend due dates, etc.  He is very reasonable.
ratings.ratingTags: Get ready to read--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--EXTRA CREDIT
